title: The Ice Queen�s Sister
description:
In part one the Ice Queen seduced, hypnotized and enslaved you. Now you're trapped in her castle, caged and alone... until her sweet, innocent sister finds you and mounts a daring rescue that is!

But wait... why are you getting more dazed the more you follow her? And why are you going upstairs and not outside? Have you escaped from the freezing pan, into the fire of this cute, kinda crazy girl?
